subject.title: fix(sms): ack rate-limited Twilio callbacks instead of dropping them [AI]

question: Should the SMS plugin report HTTP 200 for a signature-validated callback that it intentionally discards, or reserve success for callbacks that were dispatched or durably accepted?
rationale: Both choices are implementable, but they define externally visible delivery, fallback, and monitoring semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Preserve acceptance semantics
options.body: Keep a non-2xx response for discarded callbacks and pursue durable bounded queuing separately if lossless burst handling is required.

options.title: Adopt ack-and-drop explicitly
options.body: Accept HTTP 200 for discarded callbacks, document that fallback and failure monitoring are bypassed, and require live Twilio proof plus dedicated drop metrics.

recommendation.title: Preserve acceptance semantics
recommendation.body: Keep a non-2xx response for discarded callbacks and pursue durable bounded queuing separately if lossless burst handling is required.

likelyOwner.reason: The current accepted-callback quota and its HTTP response contract originate from their merged SMS webhook work.
